title: load_skill
description: Input schema for the litany built-in `load_skill` tool (ARCH §3.3 Body-on-demand). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model call's `tools: [...]` array.

name.description: Name of the skill to load — one of the names advertised in the always-present skill descriptions. Must be a single directory name (no path separators). The harness copies that skill's body from the pool into your worktree at `skills/<name>/`, where it becomes part of your context on the next model call.
